title: Rename the migration scripts
description: Our other services name their Prisma scripts `migrate:dev` and `migrate:deploy`; this one matches them, so the shared deploy pipeline can run `npm run migrate:deploy` everywhere.

comments.issue: The README still tells developers to run `npm run db:migrate` and says deploys run `npm run db:deploy`; both scripts no longer exist, so following the docs fails. Update the README with the new names.
